chapters.label: The lob, live
chapters.text: The Rose Bowl, 1994. Romania against Colombia at the World Cup. Gheorghe Hagi gets the ball wide on the left, forty yards out. He looks up. The keeper is off his line! Hagi lifts it... Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again. His left foot slides under the ball, and it floats high.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: Córdoba scrambles back, but it drops into the far corner.

chapters.label: Look up!
chapters.text: Romania won three-one! The secret? Always look up. If the keeper is off the line, a well-weighted lob can beat them from far away.
